about.body:
SofiaGO is a map catalog of places in Sofia — restaurants, cafes, shops, services and attractions in one place, instead of a dozen tabs and scattered reviews.

The catalog is filled by users themselves. Found a good place that's not on the map yet? Add it in a couple of minutes — photo, address, category, coordinates. Before publishing, we review every new listing by hand, so the catalog stays full of real, useful places.

The project is young and constantly evolving. If you found a bug, have a suggestion, or a question — write to us: :support_email.
